text:
Hannah: hey team :wave: I just received my Fedora laptop (Fedora 36) from IT and trying to bootstrap devenv. using asdf to install ruby 3.1 and python 3.11 but the builds fail during openssl link step. also can't clone the private dotfiles repo — Okta SSO redirects to a blank page. who do I ping for what?
Matt: welcome @Hannah! cc @Sree for the OS package stuff. quick Q: paste the exact asdf install command and the short error log. which asdf plugins are you using?
Hannah: running `asdf install ruby 3.1.2` and `asdf install python 3.11.4`. error copy: ```
compiling openssl
ld: cannot find -lcrypto
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [link_open] Error 1
```
Hannah: also `openssl version` -> "OpenSSL 1.1.1k 25 Mar 2021" (system).
Sree: ok two things likely: missing devel packages and PKG_CONFIG path mismatch on Fedora. run: `sudo dnf install -y openssl-devel zlib-devel bzip2-devel libffi-devel xz-devel gcc make pkgconfig`
Sree: if you still hit linker errors try exporting before asdf build: ```
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/usr/lib64/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib64/pkgconfig"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/lib64:/usr/lib64"
export OPENSSL_DIR="/usr"
```
Sree: for some asdf plugins (ruby) you might also need `RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl-dir=$OPENSSL_DIR" asdf install ruby 3.1.2`
Omar: for the dotfiles/Okta issue — our SSO sometimes blocks headless webviews. use a browser with your Okta session and then try the git clone link. if that fails, get a one-time access token from People Ops or ask IT to add you to the "engineering" okta group.
Matt: also add your SSH key to the git repo via the web UI once SSO works. commands we usually run on Fedora at bootstrap: ```
# install system deps
sudo dnf update -y
sudo dnf install -y git curl openssh-clients gnupg2 pass
# asdf deps
sudo dnf install -y bison libyaml-devel libffi-devel readline-devel
```
Matt: and enable direnv in your shell if your dotfiles use it: add `eval "$(direnv hook bash)"` (or fish/zsh equivalent) to your shell rc.
Hannah: tried the dnf install + exports, re-ran asdf for ruby and python — ruby build succeeded! python wheel build also worked after adding xz-devel. thanks :tada:
Hannah: Okta still glitchy though — when I click the repo link I get a blank okta page.
Omar: ping IT support with your employee id and request the "repo-clone" SSO waiver; while they process it, you can ask a buddy to add your public key (or they can invite your GitHub account).
Matt: FYI if you prefer, drop me a screenshot and I can trigger a People Ops request. also remember to run `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `git config --global user.signingkey <your-gpg-key>` if you sign commits.
deploy-bot: device registration detected for hannah-laptop (asset id HN-2345) — if this isn't you, file a ticket.
Hannah: all set — ruby + python working, dotfiles cloning queued with IT, direnv hooked. huge thanks everyone :pray: will ping if anything else pops up.
